notes.title: Official Release Date: May 29.
notes.notes:
📅 Official Release Date: May 29. 

It’s time to face the fear. We’re thrilled to announce that Submersed 2: The Hive will launch on May 29! Add it to your Wishlist and get ready to descend into the dark.

notes.title: New Update Available
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44848421/ad7b218fbce167e102fb4a1b1fdd2e744f7941aa.png[/img]
We have listened to the feedback you have given us these days and we have a new update available with new features and fixes.

[b]Features[/b]
[list]
[*] Added fully support to Xbox controllers on menus
[*] Added support to DualSense
[*] Added a help window to show the keyboard controls
[*] Added localization in Italian, German, French and Portuguese
[*] Added support for 2K and 4K resolutions
[/list]
[b]Fixes[/b]
[list]
[*] Solved bug with save system
[*] Solved bug that repeats dialogs
[*] Solved bugs on English localization
[*] Minor bugs fixed
[/list]
